data.disagreement_analysis: The deepseek model returned an 'inconclusive' verdict due to a tool error (LLMResponseError: empty response), while the qwen model correctly identified the package as safe. There was no actual disagreement in security assessment.
coverage_issues: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash failed to evaluate the PKGBUILD due to an LLM response error.
learnings: Implement automatic retries or fallback mechanisms for LLM response errors to prevent tool failures from triggering unnecessary escalation audits.
Ensure models are calibrated to quickly recognize standard, pinned binary packages as safe without over-analyzing routine packaging patterns.
